SECTION 24

24. Refund & Cancellation Policy

At Websirg, refunds and cancellations are handled according to the nature of the service, project stage, and payment terms agreed with the client.

24.1 Project Cancellation Before Work Begins

If a client requests cancellation before development or other agreed work has started, the refund will be considered based on the amount already paid and any non-refundable costs incurred by Websirg.

Any applicable refund will be processed after deducting legitimate costs or expenses already incurred for the project.

24.2 Cancellation After Work Has Started

Once work has started, payments may become non-refundable to the extent that the payment has been allocated toward:

  • • Development work
  • • Design work
  • • Research and planning
  • • Project setup
  • • Third-party services
  • • Domain or hosting costs
  • • Software, plugins, licenses, or other project-related expenses

Any eligible refund will be evaluated based on the work completed and costs incurred up to the cancellation date.

24.3 Advance Payments

Advance payments are generally made to reserve project resources and initiate the agreed work. Once substantial project work has commenced, the advance payment may be non-refundable unless otherwise agreed in writing.

24.4 Third-Party Charges

Payments made for third-party services, including but not limited to:

  • • Domain registration
  • • Web hosting
  • • Premium plugins
  • • Software licenses
  • • APIs
  • • Advertising platforms
  • • Email/SMS/WhatsApp services
  • • Other third-party subscriptions

may be non-refundable because such charges are governed by the respective third-party provider's policies.

24.5 Digital Marketing & Advertising

Advertising budgets paid to Google, Meta, or other advertising platforms are separate from Websirg's service fees. Once an advertising budget has been deposited or spent on an advertising platform, its refund will be subject to the applicable platform's policies.

Websirg does not guarantee refunds for advertising spend that has already been used by an advertising platform.

24.6 Refund Requests

Refund requests should be submitted to:

Email: info@websirg.com

The request should include:

  • • Client name
  • • Project/service name
  • • Invoice or payment reference, if available
  • • Reason for requesting a refund

Websirg will review the request and communicate the applicable decision according to the agreed project terms.

24.7 Approved Refunds

Where a refund is approved, it will generally be processed using the original payment method, where technically possible. The time required for the refund to appear in the client's account may depend on the payment gateway, bank, or financial institution.

24.8 Non-Refundable Completed Work

Completed Work: Payments relating to work that has already been completed, delivered, approved, or accepted by the client may not be eligible for a refund unless otherwise agreed in writing or required by applicable law.

24.9 Disputes

Before initiating a payment dispute or chargeback, clients are encouraged to contact Websirg at info@websirg.com so that the matter can be reviewed and resolved where possible.

Nothing in this Refund Policy limits any rights or remedies that cannot legally be excluded under applicable law.
